editorial.blurb: This beloved neighborhood Korean spot delivers authentic, soul-warming dishes at gentle prices, run by a genuinely kind couple who treat you like family.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive on a weekday evening around 6pm when it's quieter, order the charbroiled mackerel and pan-broiled octopus (not just the expected dishes), and don't skip the complimentary pancake—though consider ordering the seafood pancake too since it's even better than the free one.
